record.paper_title: Boundary and Defect CFT: Open Problems and Applications
record.original_question: How should one incorporate finite-string-tension corrections, i.e. 1/λ corrections, into the large-N, large-'t Hooft-coupling analysis of four-point correlators in AdS5 × S5 supergravity?

evidence.quote: It would be interesting to discuss 1/λ corrections.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider type IIB superstring theory on the background AdS_5 × S^5 with N units of five-form flux, in the planar/large-N limit at large 't Hooft coupling λ. The leading two-derivative supergravity approximation governs the holographic four-point correlation functions of single-trace half-BPS superconformal primary operators (e.g. the stress-tensor multiplet superprimaries) in the dual N=4 super Yang-Mills theory; these correlators have been computed in supergravity at leading order in 1/N^2 and in the strict λ → ∞ limit.

Finite-string-tension effects correspond to a systematic expansion in inverse powers of λ (equivalently, in α'/L^2 where L is the AdS radius), generated by higher-derivative corrections to the type IIB effective action (such as the α'^3 R^4 term and its supersymmetric completions).

Problem. Develop a systematic procedure to incorporate the 1/λ (finite-string-tension) corrections to the large-N, large-λ supergravity computation of four-point correlation functions of half-BPS single-trace operators in AdS_5 × S^5. Specifically:
(a) Determine, to a given order in 1/λ, the form of the corresponding tree-level Mellin amplitude (or position-space correlator) that is consistent with superconformal Ward identities, crossing symmetry, and the analytic/polynomial-degree growth expected from higher-derivative bulk vertices.
(b) Fix any remaining undetermined coefficients in this expansion using independent input (e.g. localization on S^4, integrated correlator constraints, or the flat-space limit reproducing the Virasoro–Shapiro amplitude).
(c) Extract the resulting predictions for the anomalous dimensions and OPE coefficients of double-trace operators at each order in 1/λ.
artifact.category_tag: Holographic correlators and stringy corrections in AdS/CFT
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made on incorporating 1/λ (stringy α') corrections into half-BPS four-point correlators in AdS_5 × S^5. Tree-level corrections have been determined up to high orders (e.g. through O(α'^7)) by combining superconformal symmetry, crossing, the flat-space Virasoro–Shapiro limit, and constraints from supersymmetric localization (integrated correlators), with results extended to genus expansion in 1/N^2. The general problem of resumming all 1/λ corrections—i.e. constructing the full Virasoro–Shapiro amplitude in AdS_5 × S^5—remains open, though concrete systematic frameworks have been developed.

status_evidence.title: Towards the Virasoro-Shapiro amplitude in AdS5×S5
status_evidence.snippet: Systematic procedure for stringy corrections to single-trace 1/2-BPS correlators up to O(α'^7).
status_evidence.claim: Stringy 1/λ corrections to half-BPS four-point correlators have been computed systematically to high order, but the full Virasoro–Shapiro amplitude in AdS5×S5 is not yet known.

status_evidence.title: Genus-2 holographic correlator on AdS5 × S5 from localization
status_evidence.snippet: Localization constraints fix R^4 correction to holographic correlator to any order in the genus expansion.
status_evidence.claim: Localization constraints have been used to fix specific 1/λ corrections at higher genus in 1/N^2.

status_evidence.title: On genus-one string amplitudes on AdS5 × S5
status_evidence.snippet: Loop supergravity and tower of stringy corrections have simple Mellin-space structure.
status_evidence.claim: Mellin-space organization of 1/λ corrections is established at genus one, but the full tower remains under active study.
